text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I began
working with <chrname>.
One day, we arrive at the
racetrack and
see...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... I did it! I'm first!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy, Teio. Paced running isn't
about who
finishes first.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Wheeze! Cough! Finally... finished...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! You okay, Tsuru? Ooh, what
do I keep
telling you about pushing your
limits like that?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Slow and steady wins the race—there's
no need to rush. We still have time, so
catch your breath,
and then we can
move on from there.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! Breathe in... Breathe out... In...
And out...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sorry about that! I got carried
away at the
thought of being able to
train with everybody!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... But I suspect that's what's behind
your success. I feel like every time I see
you two these
days, you're growing by
leaps and bounds.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Relying only on oneself for motivation
has its limits. There are heights that can
only be reached by combining our
strength and using each other as
springboards to leap ever higher.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see the both of you continue
working
toward mutual improvement, to
reach those lofty
peaks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The both of us? Like, just us?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We both want to improve along with you, Prez! That's what we thought we were doing this entire time!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies! I have a terrible habit
of
speaking as though I'm not part of the
equation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying that I've also
gained much
from running together with
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, you take your straightforward
fighting spirit
into every race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And Tsuyoshi, you possess an earnest,
tireless drive to improve yourself. You've
both pushed me
to become a better
runner.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your daily, prodigious efforts are an
inspiration
to me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... P-President Rudolf! I'm so touched!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! But don't think we'll go easy on
you just
'cause you said some nice
things!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If we keep improving at this rate, pretty
soon,
you'll be the one trying to catch
up with us!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You said it,
Teio! All right! I'm all fired
up and
ready to go again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then what are we waiting for?
How about
ten incline dashes,
back-to-back?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Mrgh! I won't give up! C'mon, Tsuyoshi!
You got
this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You two truly are prodigious... Hehe. I'm
glad I
have you to rely on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With their break over, the three start
running again. I watch them go, burning
the sight of their
camaraderie into my
mind.
